controls.title: Machine-readable API contract exists when API is public or shared
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: Machine-readable API contract exists when API is public or shared?
controls.pass_condition: A recognizable OpenAPI, Swagger, or AsyncAPI machine-readable contract exists.
controls.partial_condition: A candidate contract exists but cannot be recognized/validated sufficiently.
controls.fail_condition: An API surface is detected without a recognizable machine-readable contract.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.

controls.title: API contract passes lint and schema checks
manual_questions: What concrete evidence supports: API contract passes lint and schema checks?
controls.pass_condition: PASS when TEST_RESULT evidence directly demonstrates "API contract passes lint and schema checks" for the applicable scope; the review/test addresses this check: Use Spectral/schema validation when available; and no material contradictory evidence remains.
controls.partial_condition: PARTIAL when evidence for "API contract passes lint and schema checks" exists but is incomplete in scope, freshness, execution, or authority, or when the required check is only partly demonstrated: Use Spectral/schema validation when available.
controls.fail_condition: FAIL when applicable evidence contradicts "API contract passes lint and schema checks", the required capability is materially absent, or the check cannot be demonstrated after review: Use Spectral/schema validation when available.
controls.not_applicable_condition: Applicability engine records NOT_APPLICABLE with an explicit reason.
